messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands in profile, then slowly turns his head and upper body to look upward and to his right.","camera":"A medium shot from the waist up, positioned at a low angle, remains mostly static while the subject moves.","clothing":"A dark navy military-style tunic with a high collar, white piping, gold shoulder insignia, and a row of gold buttons, cinched with a brown leather belt and gold buckle.","hair_color":"Black with a few gray strands visible at the temples.","hairstyle":"Dark hair swept back from the forehead and tied into a small topknot bun at the crown.","identity":"A 3D-rendered adult male with a tanned complexion, prominent eyebrows, and a short mustache.","scene":"An outdoor paved area beneath a concrete overpass, with a metal guardrail, green trees, a construction crane, and a red and yellow sign visible in the background under a bright sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output changes from a full-body low-angle shot to a waist-up medium shot from a front three-quarter angle. The opening framing closely matches the reference image, and the subject continues the same slow head/upper-body turn and upward gaze in the same overpass environment.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle, matching the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, environment, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the subtle facial and hairstyle differences are unintended identity changes or acceptable rendering variation.
unexpected_changes: The subject's face and hair appear altered in some frames: the topknot is less visible, facial features look different, and gray hair is more prominent than in the source.
